answer: Split tally stops fake identities. Each agent splits its work in two. One half rides the tide board. The other is carved on basalt. Two auditors add each half; both must match. An honest sparrow pays 38 once, locks a 60-credit bond, refunded when clean. A forger fakes two halves per identity: first 38, kth 38+7(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500, lock 60,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented half carries its lender's key, so both bonds burn.
